dogecoin.text:
I was randomly checking top gainers @binance and saw #dogecoin going crazy. Then checked Twitter and saw the news about Elon Musk buying Twitter for $44 billion. 
Not all news is the same, but when Elon gets involved, the entire world feels it.

Elon Musk buys Twitter. 
Expecting to see $Doge the new official coin of Twitter in about 6 months tops. 
#ElonMuskTwitter #dogecoin #DogecoinToTheMoon
Like it or not, #Dogecoin is coming to Twitter (and to the rest of the world)
@DogechainFamily Giving away $Doge would be too easy, so it must be something else. Something related to crypto though, like a wallet, but I guess more expensive 🤔
